name: CC Card Dance
description: Splits the layer into a grid of 3D cards whose position, rotation and scale are driven by two gradient maps, like After Effects Card Dance: each of X, Y, Z position, X, Y, Z rotation and X, Y scale picks Gradient 1, Gradient 2 or random with a multiplier and offset. Gradients can be the layer brightness, the layers below, linear, radial, animated noise or waves. Back side shows the layer or a color, with perspective and lighting.
